item.title: MSIM - Because your business cannot afford to go offline!
item.description: MSIM is an innovative technology that allows a single SIM card to connect automatically to up to 6 different mobile networks in the USA, and across 350+ mobile networks in 188 countries, ensuring the best available signal at all times. This means you don’t need two SIM cards, and you won’t lose internet connectivity when you need it most.
